name: Carrion, Father of Evolution
speaker: entity:carrion_father_of_evolution
lines: Oh? Salutations! It looks like as if you finally arrived.
Well I can only assume [Klaris](entity:klaris_llfiend_mother_of_lights) and her little brigade were on their way here, unless you work for someone else? That would be quite a twist!

*He lets out an audible sigh.* How disappointing.. Well get going then, [Ethiron](entity:ethiron_the_maelstroms_eye) is sure to wake momentarily. [Divers](faction:the_divers) are all the same now, all work and no passion.

I really must be getting old, it slipped my mind that no one has been to this City in decades. The egg hatches soon, little diver. The wails of the screaming child born under the snow will bring it all crashing down. ANYWAY, do you happen to have any rare monster parts?

No no no. NO. I am not about to get caught up in the affairs of Klaris and her little superhero group. I want nothing to do with stopping [Ethiron](entity:ethiron_the_maelstroms_eye) or anything of that nature. Look, you went toe to toe with [Chaser](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract). He's probably one of the strongest Divers that the Citadel has ever produced, save for [Akira](entity:akira) and Klaris. You have this completely under control... probably.

*He looks at you with a puzzled expression.* No? Should I be? That's what you're here for after all, correct? *His mouth twitches into a smile momentarily and just as soon back to a puzzling frown. You can sense that man is cackling internally, laughing at your expense.*
You can call me.... Dr. Diver.
What makes a name real or fake? If it's what I want you to call me, then who are you to say that my name isn't real? The manners of surface dwellers haven't improved with time I see.
